details.questions: This is the public NIST WWV automated listening service. Remain silent, listen for one complete spoken UTC time announcement, record the exact spoken words and UTC time, and hang up immediately after that announcement. Do not mistake the recorded time announcement for voicemail. Do not leave any message. Do not share personal details or names, book anything, change any account, or buy anything. Do not request a callback or connect the user. If a real person unexpectedly answers, politely end without asking anything. End within two minutes. Exactly one call is authorized, with no redial.
